_comment: Alert rules as code (NFR-17). Destinations (emails, phone numbers) are NOT stored here: they live in the vendor accounts (docs/ops/setup.md). Application code raises these by tagging a Sentry event / log line with alert=<id> (docs/ops/runbook.md, 'Tag convention'). Validated by ops/check_ops.py.

routes.founder-push: Founder phone push (Sentry/Better Stack app) or SMS/WhatsApp once chosen

alerts.title: Payment collection failed or stuck
alerts.condition: event tag alert=failed-payment (MoMo/card collection error, callback mismatch, stuck pending)
alerts.threshold: 3 events in 15 minutes, or any single event with tag severity=critical

alerts.title: Scheduled job failed or did not run
alerts.condition: event tag alert=job-failure (job raised, exhausted retries, or tick lock stuck)
alerts.threshold: 2 failures of the same job within 30 minutes

alerts.title: Safeguarding case not acknowledged in time
alerts.condition: event tag alert=safeguarding-unacked (case open and unacknowledged past the SLA)
alerts.threshold: 1 event; SLA from the safeguarding policy (default 30 minutes)
alerts.owner_role: safeguarding lead, then backup, then founder

alerts.title: API or admin unreachable
alerts.condition: /health or admin check failing for confirm_after_failures consecutive checks (ops/uptime.json)

alerts.title: Elevated API 5xx rate
alerts.condition: share of requests with status >= 500 (structured request log lines)
alerts.threshold: more than 5% of requests over 5 minutes, with at least 20 requests

alerts.title: Monitoring itself may be down (heartbeat missing)
alerts.condition: the core job tick pings a heartbeat URL every 5 minutes; no ping seen
